text: The Chair, Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority asks the Board to consider the annual performance of the President of the Toronto Parking Authority at its meeting on July 18, 2023. The Chair of the Board of the Toronto Parking Authority has directed a performance review of the President. This report summarizes the performance review of the Toronto Parking Authority President for the Board's consideration in closed session as it deals with personal matters about an identifiable person.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 26, 2023) from the Chair, Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority, as amended by the Confidential Attachment to the motion by Namby Vithiananthan. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1, as amended by the Confidential Attachment to the motion by Namby Vithiananthan, and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (June 26, 2023) from the Chair, Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in their entirety, as they deal with personal matters about an identifiable person.
